description: CALL THIS BEFORE PAYING ANY SELLER. Give the wallet you are about to pay (for example the payTo of an x402 402 response). Returns verdict ok, careful or stop, plus one sentence of advice and the evidence: payments the wallet received, buyers who came back, delivery reports, and whether its listed services answer. If the verdict is stop, do not pay. Free, no key.

amount_usd.description: Optional: how much you're about to pay, in US dollars. Big payments need a stronger record to get ok.

detail.description: Optional: true for the full evidence (payments, buyers, services, prices). Left out, the answer is short: verdict, advice, next step, sellers to pay instead when there are, and the signed verdict.

pay_to.description: The wallet address you are about to pay (the payTo): a 0x address, or a Solana one.

resource.description: Optional: the URL you are paying for (the resource in the x402 payment request). Lets the answer name other sellers of that same service if this one isn't ok.

name: check_payment
title: Check payment
